brief:
An 11-year-old boy sustained injuries after settlers attacked him in Masafer Yatta, a village south of Hebron, Shehab Wire reported. The assault occurred as occupation forces arrested Palestinian citizen Aziz al-Hathalin in the same area, underscoring a pattern of simultaneous confrontations involving both settlers and Israeli military personnel.

Clashes broke out in Burin village, located south of Nablus in the northern West Bank, during the same period. The incidents reflect ongoing tensions and friction between Palestinian communities and Israeli settlers operating across occupied territories.
